title: Super Supportive · Episode 2: Inside the Silver Bubble
description: Alden asks Hannah for the truth about the night his parents died.

sources.title: Super Supportive — Sleyca

choicesAndCallbacks: Four local attention or conversation intentions with immediate distinct responses; no persistent changes to canonical events.
sceneActivities: Seated hospital conversation; hands and gaze carry tension. No looping exercise or travel.
planning.voiceReason: A child seeking concrete truth and a rescuer struggling to answer him; source-supported vulnerability drives the scene.

signatures.Alden: Short concrete questions; attentive stillness gives way to clutching blankets and loss of composure.
signatures.Hannah: Hesitant but precise answers; speaks directly about responsibility, pauses under strain.
signatures.Amanda: Protective immediate response in the final scene; no invented speech beyond comfort.

planning.directing: Hold shared pair through ordinary answers; frame Alden when the decisive disclosure lands, then Continue-controlled aftermath. Preserve seated states.

planning.desire: Understand the bubble and how the disaster reached his street.
planning.obstacle: Hannah’s discomfort and the complexity of what happened.
planning.payoff: The bubble and pursuit are explained; Alden sees Hannah’s honesty about the limits of her knowledge.

continuation.end: Hannah explains the bubble and the pursuit to the empty building. Alden learns that even his rescuer does not fully understand her powers.
continuation.nextStart: “We managed to chase the villain in there,” Hannah said.
continuation.note: Hannah’s role, wrong-floor admission and Alden’s grief; complete chapter TWO.

contains: 那天在我房间里的，就是那个坏人吗？
他能拿走别人的力量和生命，变成自己的。他害的人越多，自己就越强。
我记得那种安静。她不是什么都知道，却真的让我活了下来。
对。那是我们最先看见的空房子。
routes.endsWith: 现在我知道了，他们为什么会来到我家对面。可那个人，最后怎么会进了我的房间？

contains: 是那个人让我爸爸妈妈死的吗？
对。用那个来说明，你可能更容易明白。
我以为，她一定什么都明白。她说自己也不清楚，还要好好想想。
对。那是我们最先看见的空房子。

teaser.videoPrompt: Animate this exact ink-wash hospital illustration in one continuous six-second shot. Preserve identities, ages, costumes, room, framing, paper texture and medium. The eight-year-old boy Alden, alone in the image is the ONLY speaker. The entire spoken script in clear natural ENGLISH, exactly once: "Why did he kill my parents?". Speak only those words between seconds 0.5 and 3.5, with synchronized lips; afterward mouth closed. No extra words, repetition, paraphrase, filler, humming, singing, narration or other voices. Quiet restrained emotional delivery, clearly above very soft rain ambience. Tiny natural eye/head movement; hands stay still on blanket or knees. No camera cuts, no new objects, no injuries. The boy asks with urgent quiet seriousness, then holds his gaze toward the unseen woman.

checks.transcription: Why did he kill my parents?

teaser.imagePromptBrief: Illustration-story, landscape 16:9. Use Alden A and Episode 1 hospital image for identity only. Preserve eight-year-old Alden’s ordinary face, brown eyes, small straight nose, tousled brown fringe, blue star pajamas and Wummy. Expressive Chinese ink-wash on textured xuan paper: calligraphic contours, dry-brush hair, gray washes, sparse indigo and warm ochre, paper negative space. Alden propped in hospital bed, hands clutching blanket, medium chest-up three-quarter portrait, questioning brow, looking toward offscreen Hannah. Rain-streaked window. No literal magic bubble, text, logos or visible injuries.
